tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.contract_description: Record only a rating the guest explicitly gave on the 1–5 scale. Never invent a rating from thanks, a goodbye, positive sentiment or a successful journey. Include resolved only if the guest explicitly said whether their issue was resolved; otherwise omit it. A polite ending alone is not feedback submission.

acceptance: All 17 variants, repeated three times, must pass provider evaluation and the independent trace audit. V9 is prepared, not accepted.
